# Mod files

<!-- Generated by `capture mods docs` from the lockfiles. Edit those, not this page. -->

`capture install <game>` needs these third-party files. None of them is in this repository.
Put what you have in `out/mods/` (or pass `--mods <folder, archive or bundle>`): archives can
stay exactly as downloaded, files are recognised by their SHA-256, not by name or folder.

- **Download**: `capture mods fetch <game>` downloads these and checks their hashes.
- **Supply yourself**: may not be redistributed, so get them from the page given.
- `capture mods status <game>` shows what was found on this machine and what is missing.
- To set up another of your own machines without downloading again, make a bundle on a machine
  that has everything: `capture mods bundle <game> -o mods.zip --with-supplied`, then
  `capture install <game> --mods mods.zip` there. Keep such a bundle off the internet and out of
  git: it holds files that may not be redistributed.

The lockfiles pin the versions this repository was tested with:
`capture/install/mods.lock.json` (every game) and `adapters/<game>/mods.lock.json`.

## Grand Theft Auto V Legacy (story mode, Steam)

### Script Hook V 3889.0 / 1158.13 (with its ASI loader and Native Trainer)

**Required.** Loads script plug-ins into the game (the ASI loader, dinput8.dll) and lets them call the game's functions. Everything that drives GTA V runs through it. This build supports GTA V Legacy 1.0.3889.0 and Enhanced 1.0.1158.13; a game update needs a new build. Native Trainer is optional (--no-native-trainer).

### NaturalVision Enhanced, July 2026 build ("Next-Gen Graphics Update #2 Updated")

**Optional.** A graphics overhaul for GTA V Enhanced by Razed: its own lighting, weather, clouds, tonemapping and colours, roads, vegetation, interiors and vehicles (the onigiri loader and its DLC packs), and shader replacements loaded through ReShade's add-on API (NVE.asi). The capture default for Enhanced (--no-graphics-mod leaves it out). Only its own files: its ASI loader (xinput1_4.dll), ReShade.asi, ReShade.ini and photo-mode effects are left out, since ours are installed.

| | |
|---|---|
| How to get it | **Supply yourself**: https://razedmods.com/gtavenhanced |

| Licence | Razed; free to use, no redistribution stated (may NOT be redistributed) |
| Note | Free from the page above (its download links, under older versions). The newer "#3 V2" build hangs Enhanced 1.0.1158.13 while loading; this build runs. Its settings live in %APPDATA%\NVE\settings-gen9.json. 6.5 GB, so it is installed straight from the archive (capture/install/components/pack.py) and never bundled. |
| Lockfile | `adapters/gtav/mods.lock.json`, id `nve` |
